description: negative control for the stdout-not-contains needle at both levels: no generate step runs (the entrypoint and crate keys the kind requires go unused); the one exercise step runs the harness itself, through its fx-env link under a harness name, over the materialized copy of this scenario's committed inner suite. Each inner scenario forbids a substring its run prints — one in a positive expect over the help output, one in a codegen-oracle exercise step — so the inner run must exit 1, fail both scenarios with the forbidden-needle report, and report no other failure

command: ln "$(command -v fx-env)" kdlith-fixtures || exit 2; ./kdlith-fixtures --fx-suite inner --fx-kdlith "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" --fx-scratch-root inner-scratch --test-threads 1 2>&1; status=$?; echo "inner exit=$status"; test "$status" -eq 1
stdout-contains:
---- forbidden-needle ----
  - stdout contains forbidden "Usage: kdlith"
---- forbidden-needle-step ----
oracle step 1 (exercise): stdout contains forbidden "forbidden-marker"
test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 2 failed
inner exit=1
